message.starbridge.not_owner: Only the ship owner or an operator can control this core.
message.starbridge.core_selected: Core selected. /starbridge pilot · /starbridge hold · /starbridge navigate x y z. Right-click with furnace fuel to charge.
message.starbridge.slate_bind: Use the slate on your flight core. Chart the Moon with a spyglass under clear skies, or use your Unbound telescope.
message.starbridge.moon_charted: Moon chart complete. Its flight path is now stored in your navigation slate.
message.starbridge.vent_charge: Cabin oxygen: %s person-seconds. Use an oxygen canister to refill.
message.starbridge.voyage_begun: Course set for %s. The arrival procedure is underway.
message.starbridge.voyage_arrived: Arrived at %s. The ship is berthed.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.moon: Seal two lunar samples with core tubes, then bring them home to craft a lunar reference chart.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.mars: Archive signal at %s, %s, %s. Expose the carved stone and use a sample tube to take a rubbing.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.belt: Wreck signal at %s, %s, %s. Use a sample tube on the copper recorder. Rescue orders target the blue-ice capsule four blocks east.
campaign.starbridge.arrival.relay: Anchor at %s, %s, %s. Place your relay terminal above the carved foundation and deliver antenna sections, copper and redstone blocks.
campaign.starbridge.no_site: No clear expedition site near this berth. Clear the approach between X 0–32 and Z 32–64, then return.
campaign.starbridge.home_calibration: Calibrate this chart in the Overworld after your return.
campaign.starbridge.calibrated.1: Mars and asteroid-belt routes calibrated. Return with two archive rubbings or flight recorders for the deep space chart.
campaign.starbridge.calibrated.2: Deep space route calibrated. Take a relay terminal, 3 antenna sections, 32 copper ingots and 8 redstone blocks to the anchor.
campaign.starbridge.tube_help: Use a tube on lunar rock, a Martian archive engraving, a wreck recorder or a contracted rescue pod.
campaign.starbridge.inventory_full: Make room for the shipment in your inventory.
campaign.starbridge.wrong_site: Install the terminal above the marked foundation at the deep space relay.
campaign.starbridge.materials: Deliver to terminal: antenna sections %s/%s, copper ingots %s/%s, redstone blocks %s/%s.
campaign.starbridge.online: %s brought the deep space relay online. Dispatch is accepting shipments.
campaign.starbridge.order.supply: Supply run: deliver 16 bread together to provision the relief crew. Payout: 4 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.order.survey: Survey run: deliver one archive rubbing from the Martian dig. Payout: 4 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.order.rescue: Rescue run: take a sample tube to the blue-ice escape pod at the belt wreck. Bring the occupied capsule here. Payout: 6 emeralds.
campaign.starbridge.adv.samples.title: Cargo from the Moon
campaign.starbridge.adv.samples.desc: Collect a physical lunar core sample.
campaign.starbridge.adv.chart.title: The Next Two Horizons
campaign.starbridge.adv.chart.desc: Return with lunar material and craft a chart. Use it at home to enable Mars and the belt.
campaign.starbridge.adv.deep.title: Fix on the Dark
campaign.starbridge.adv.deep.desc: Combine Mars or belt records into a deep space chart and calibrate it at home.
campaign.starbridge.adv.online.title: A Light in Deep Space
campaign.starbridge.adv.online.desc: Take part in a working relay station at the deep-space anchor.
campaign.starbridge.adv.dispatch.title: First Relief Flight
campaign.starbridge.adv.dispatch.desc: Deliver a shipment ordered by the deep space relay.
campaign.starbridge.wrong_rescue_order: This capsule belongs to a previous relief flight. Recover the crew for the current dispatch at the belt.
